name: 26 Tr Solaris
variant: Solaris New Trollino 12 body, Škoda SJ 10.1 equipment (DPMŽ Žilina)

costs.note: DPMŽ tender 2016, price per vehicle excl. VAT; 26TrA with traction battery (2019 order): 598,000 EUR excl. VAT. As reported by imhd.sk.

livery.description: White, yellow and green DPMŽ colour scheme ("bielo-žlto-zelená farebná schéma"), as described by imhd.sk; hex values approximate, yellow not represented.

sources.title: Škoda 26 Tr Solaris – vehicle type description

notes: First trolleybuses with the Solaris New Trollino body (Žilina, from December 2017; 9 x 26 Tr, 2 x 26TrA). Škoda SJ 10.1 IGBT converter with regeneration, rated 600/750 V DC; one Škoda 4ML 3444 K/4 asynchronous motor, 160 kW. Height with pantographs lowered. Floor 320 mm (250 mm kneeling). Wheelbase 5,900 mm. Seats 30 + 1 + 1 (driver and an extra seat not split out), standing 60, total given as 90 + 1 + 1. Empty weight 11,800 kg ± 3 %. 26TrA variant: 45.4 kWh Škoda TBS 5.1 traction battery, 25 + 1 seats, 45 standing, 12,950 kg empty, 19,500 kg gross; off-wire range not published.
